simple.meaning: מְדֻשָּׁה (mᵉdushshâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a threshing , i.e. (concretely and figuratively) down-trodden people.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Isaiah 21:10. The surrounding context includes Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְדֻשָּׁה (H4098) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מְדֻשָּׁה (mᵉdushshâh) / H4098 is traced through Isaiah 21:10 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: a threshing , i.e. (concretely and figuratively) down-trodden people
definitions.full: H4098. medushshah [ מְדֻשָֿׁה ] noun feminine that which is threshed ; suffix מְדֻשָֿׁתִי Isa 21:10 (|| בֶּןגָּֿרְנִי ) figurative in address to Israel by prophet.

occurrences.englishText: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.
